# 0. Read this first (for the new Claude session)

The work is in `<owner>/<repo>`, branch **`<branch>`**. The default branch
`<default>` may not contain it.

```bash
git fetch origin <branch> && git checkout <branch>   # or merge it into your assigned branch
python3.11 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
./run_all.sh
```

Read `CLAUDE.md`, then this file. Follow the rules in section 3.

# 1. How to start a new session (for the user)

1. Go to claude.ai/code and click **New session**.
2. Pick the repository and environment. Set network access to Full if downloads
   are needed.
3. Choose branch `<branch>` if offered.
4. Upload the files in section 2.
5. Send this first message: "Read `docs/session_handoff.Rmd` on branch `<branch>`
   and `CLAUDE.md`, check out the branch, run `./run_all.sh`, then wait."

# 2. Must-upload list (files not in the repository)

| # | File | Why |
|---|------|-----|
| 1 | Reference paper PDF | copyright; not committed |
| 2 | Formatting template(s) | documents must follow them |
| 3 | Course rubric / journal guidelines | grading or submission criteria |
| 4 | Names (group, adviser), adviser comments | placeholders |

# 3. Standing rules

- Push only to `<branch>`.
- No PR unless asked.
- Raw data untouched and logged.
- Outputs only from scripts: edit the templates.
- Decisions log for every choice.
- Writing style: simple, define terms (words, then formula, then example),
  paragraphs over bullets.
